key: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control with Space Vector Modulator
title: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control with Space Vector Modulator
text: Induction machine DTC structure with SVM, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Axis prioritization} sets Axis prioritization for voltage limiter; {Stator resistance (Ohm)} sets the resistance, {Number of pole pairs} sets the pole number, {Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} sets the voltage, {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the sVM sample time 5e-6, {Control sample time (s)} sets the pI sample time 5e-5, {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate, {Flux controller proportional gain} sets the flux PI proportional gain, {Flux controller integral gain} sets the flux PI integral gain, {Flux controller anti-windup gain} sets the flux PI anti-windup gain, {Torque controller proportional gain} sets the torque PI proportional gain, {Torque controller integral gain} sets the torque PI integral gain and {Torque controller anti-windup gain} sets the torque PI anti-windup gain. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Fundamental sample time (s)
params.values: SVM sample time 5e-6 (default) | positive scalar less than the control sample time

params.name: Control sample time (s)
params.values: PI sample time 5e-5 (default) | positive scalar greater than the fundamental sample time

params.name: Flux controller proportional gain
params.values: Flux PI proportional gain 150 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Flux controller integral gain
params.values: Flux PI integral gain 3000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Flux controller anti-windup gain
params.values: Flux PI anti-windup gain 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Torque controller proportional gain
params.values: Torque PI proportional gain 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Torque controller integral gain
params.values: Torque PI integral gain 50 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Torque controller anti-windup gain
params.values: Torque PI anti-windup gain 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: Axis prioritization for voltage limiter Q-axis (default) | D-axis | D-Q equivalence
